sql-set.sql: SELECT RP.[PermissionId] AS [PermissionId], RP.[Id] AS [RolePermissionId], R.[Id] AS [RoleId], P.[PermissionValue], P.[PermissionDisplayName], P.[PermissionSetId], P.[PermissionType], P.[ActionPermissionEndPoint], P.[IsActive], AR.[DisplayName] AS [PermissionSetName], P.[ModuleId], A.[DisplayName] AS [ModuleName], P.[ApiName], R.[RoleName], R.[RoleValue] FROM [RolePermission] AS RP INNER JOIN [Permission] AS P ON RP.[PermissionId] = P.[Id] INNER JOIN [Role] AS R ON RP.[RoleId] = R.[Id] INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS A ON A.[Id] = P.[ModuleId] INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS AR ON AR.[Id] = P.[PermissionSetId] WHERE RP.[RoleId] = @RoleId;

SELECT RP.[UiPermissionId] AS [PermissionId], R.[Id] AS [RoleId], R.[RoleName], R.[RoleValue], P.[PermissionValue], P.[PermissionDisplayName], P.[UiPermissionTypeId] AS [PermissionTypeId], A.[DisplayName] AS [PermissionTypeName], P.[PermissionParentId], UP.[PermissionDisplayName] AS [PermissionParentName], P.[ModuleId], AR.[DisplayName] AS [ModuleName] FROM [RoleUiPermission] AS RP INNER JOIN [UiPermission] AS P ON RP.[UiPermissionId] = P.[Id] AND P.[IsActive] = 1 INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS A ON A.[Id] = P.[UiPermissionTypeId] INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS AR ON AR.[Id] = P.[ModuleId] LEFT JOIN [UiPermission] AS UP ON UP.[Id] = P.[PermissionParentId] INNER JOIN [Role] AS R ON RP.[RoleId] = R.[Id] WHERE (@RoleId = '0' OR RP.[RoleId] = @RoleId);

SELECT P.[Id] AS [PermissionId], P.[PermissionValue], P.[PermissionDisplayName], P.[PermissionSetId], ar.[DisplayName] AS [PermissionSetName], P.[PermissionType], P.[ModuleId], a.[DisplayName] AS [ModuleName], P.[ApiName], P.[ActionPermissionEndPoint] FROM [Permission] AS P INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] a ON a.[Id] = P.[ModuleId] INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] ar ON ar.[Id] = P.[PermissionSetId] WHERE P.[IsActive] = 1 AND P.[IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY P.[PermissionDisplayName] DESC;

UPDATE [Permission] SET [PermissionValue] = @PermissionValue, [PermissionDisplayName] = @PermissionDisplayName, [PermissionSetId] = @PermissionSetId, [PermissionType] = @PermissionType, [ModuleId] = @ModuleId, [IsActive] = @IsActive, [IsDeleted] = @IsDeleted, [IsApproved] = @IsApproved, [ApproverId] = @ApproverId, [ApprovedDateTime] = @ApprovedDateTime, [IsAuthorized] = @IsAuthorized, [AuthorizedById] = @AuthorizedById, [AuthorizedDateTime] = @AuthorizedDateTime, [UpdatedDateTime] = GETUTCDATE(), [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy WHERE [Id] = @Id;

SELECT R.[Id], R.[RoleName], R.[RoleValue] FROM [Role] AS R WHERE (R.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR R.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND ( (@RoleId IS NULL OR @RoleId = '0') OR R.[Id] = @RoleId );
-- Permission SELECT RP.[PermissionId] AS [PermissionId], P.[PermissionDisplayName], P.[PermissionValue], P.[PermissionSetId], AR.[DisplayName] AS [PermissionSetName], RP.[RoleId] AS [Id], P.[PermissionType], P.[ModuleId], A.[DisplayName] AS [ModuleName] FROM [RolePermission] AS RP JOIN [Permission] AS P ON P.[Id] = RP.[PermissionId] AND (P.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR P.[IsDeleted] = 0) INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS A ON A.[Id] = P.[ModuleId] INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS AR ON AR.[Id] = P.[PermissionSetId] WHERE (RP.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR RP.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND ( (@RoleId IS NULL OR @RoleId = '0') OR RP.[RoleId] = @RoleId );
UPDATE [UiPermission] SET [IsActive] = @IsActive, [PermissionDisplayName] = @PermissionDisplayName, [UpdatedDateTime] = @UpdatedDateTime, [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy WHERE [Id] = @PermissionId;

SELECT P.[Id] AS [PermissionId], P.[PermissionValue], P.[PermissionDisplayName], P.[UiPermissionTypeId] AS [PermissionTypeId], A.[DisplayName] AS [PermissionTypeName], P.[ModuleId], AR.[DisplayName] AS [ModuleName], P.[PermissionParentId], UI.[PermissionDisplayName] AS [PermissionParentName], P.[IsActive] FROM [UiPermission] AS P INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS A ON A.[Id] = P.[UiPermissionTypeId] INNER JOIN [AuthReferenceLookup] AS AR ON AR.[Id] = P.[ModuleId] LEFT JOIN [UiPermission] AS UI ON UI.[Id] = P.[PermissionParentId] ORDER BY P.[PermissionDisplayName] DESC;
UPDATE [UserPasswordHash] SET [PasswordHash] = @PasswordHash, [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy, [UpdatedDateTime] = @UpdatedDateTime, [UpdateReason] = @UpdateReason WHERE [UserId] = @UserId;
SELECT [UserId], [PasswordHash], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [UpdateReason] FROM [UserPasswordHash] WHERE [UserId] = @UserId;
UPDATE [User] SET [AccessLevel] = @AccessLevel, [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy WHERE [Id] = @UserId;
SELECT [AccessLevel] AS [UserAccessLevelName], [DisplayName] AS [UserAccessLevelValue] FROM [UserAccessLevel];

UPDATE [User] SET [EmpId] = @EmpId, [EmpType] = @EmpType, [FirstName] = @FirstName, [LastName] = @LastName, [SecondaryEmail] = @SecondaryEmail, [PhoneNumber] = @PhoneNumber, [Extension] = @Extension, [mobile] = @mobile, [preferred_username] = @preferred_username, [display_name] = @display_name, [given_name] = @given_name, [family_name] = @family_name, [Position] = @Position, [BusinessUnit] = @BusinessUnit, [ManagerId] = @ManagerId, [AccessLevel] = @AccessLevel, [Designation] = @Designation, [Department] = @Department, [Location] = @Location, [Organization] = @Organization, [IsActive] = @IsActive, [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy, [UpdatedDateTime] = @UpdatedDateTime WHERE [Id] = @UserId;

UPDATE [UserProfile] SET [DateOfJoining] = @DateOfJoining, [PrimarySkills] = @PrimarySkills, [SecondarySkills] = @SecondarySkills, [TertiarySkills] = @TertiarySkills, [OtherSkills] = @OtherSkills, [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy, [UpdatedDateTime] = @UpdatedDateTime WHERE [UserId] = @UserId;
SELECT R.[Id], R.[RoleName], R.[RoleValue] FROM [Role] AS R WHERE (R.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR R.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND ( (@RoleId IS NULL OR @RoleId = '0') OR R.[Id] = @RoleId );

SELECT UP.[UserId], -- UP.[UserPic], -- Uncomment if this column exists and is needed UP.[DOB], UP.[Gender], UP.[BloodGroup], UP.[PersonalEmail], UP.[DateOfJoining], UP.[PassportNumber], UP.[FatherName], UP.[MotherName], UP.[MaritalStatus], UP.[WeddingAnniversaryDate], UP.[SpouseName], UP.[SpouseDOB], UP.[HomeAddress1], UP.[HomeAddress2], UP.[City], UP.[State], UP.[HomeAddressCity], UP.[HomeAddressState], UP.[HomeAddressCountry], UP.[HomePhoneNumber], UP.[EmergencyContactNumber], UP.[EmergencyContactName], UP.[PrimarySkills], UP.[SecondarySkills], UP.[TertiarySkills], UP.[OtherSkills], UP.[Branch], UP.[LookUpCode], UP.[LinkedInUrl], U.[display_name] FROM [User] AS U INNER JOIN [UserProfile] AS UP ON UP.[UserId] = U.[Id] WHERE UP.[UserId] = @UserId;

SELECT [Id], [UserId], [LastLoginDateTime], [LastLogoutDateTime], [LastActivityDateTime], [LastActivityModule], [LastActionType], [LastActivityDetail], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDateTime], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [UpdateReason], [OwnerId], [IsActive], [IsDeleted], [IsApproved], [ApproverId], [ApprovedDateTime], [IsAuthorized], [AuthorizedById], [AuthorizedDateTime], [TenantId], [SubTenantId], [SysData], [CustomFields] FROM [UserActivity] WHERE (@UserId IS NULL OR [UserId] = @UserId) ORDER BY [LastActivityDateTime] DESC OFFSET (@PageNumber - 1) * @PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY
DELETE FROM RoleUiPermission WHERE RoleId = @RoleId;

-- User Details SELECT u.[Id] AS [UserId], u.[Email], u.[IsActive], u.[display_name] FROM [User] u WHERE u.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR u.[IsDeleted] = 0;
-- User Role Details SELECT ur.[Id] AS [UserRoleId], r.[RoleName], u.[UserName], u.[Id] AS [UserId] FROM [UserRole] ur JOIN [Role] r ON (r.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR r.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND ur.[RoleId] = r.[Id] JOIN [User] u ON (u.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR u.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND ur.[UserId] = u.[Id] WHERE ur.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR ur.[IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY r.[RoleName] ASC;
SELECT T.[Id], T.[TeamName], T.[TeamShortName], T.[Description], T.[TeamOwnerId], T.[TeamCaptainId] FROM [Team] AS T WHERE T.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR T.[IsDeleted] = 0;

SELECT T.[Id], T.[TeamName], T.[TeamShortName], T.[Description], T.[TeamOwnerId], T.[TeamCaptainId] FROM [Team] AS T WHERE (T.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR T.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND T.[Id] = @TeamId;
SELECT UT.[MemberId] FROM [TeamMember] AS UT WHERE (UT.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR UT.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND UT.[TeamId] = @TeamId;

SELECT DISTINCT T.[Id], T.[TeamName], T.[TeamShortName], T.[Description], T.[TeamOwnerId], T.[TeamCaptainId] FROM [Team] AS T INNER JOIN [TeamMember] AS UT ON UT.[TeamId] = T.[Id] WHERE (T.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR T.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND (UT.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR UT.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND UT.[MemberId] = @UserId;
DELETE FROM [TeamMember] WHERE [TeamId] = @TeamId AND [MemberId] = @MemberId;

SELECT UT.[MemberId], U.[Email], U.[UserName], U.[FirstName], U.[LastName], U.[mobile] AS [Mobile], U.[preferred_username], U.[Designation], U.[Department], U.[AccessLevel] FROM [TeamMember] AS UT INNER JOIN [User] AS U ON U.[Id] = UT.[MemberId] AND (U.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR U.[IsDeleted] = 0) WHERE (UT.[IsDeleted] IS NULL OR UT.[IsDeleted] = 0) AND UT.[TeamId] = @TeamId;
SELECT TOP 1 [Id] FROM [User] WHERE [oid] = @Oid AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0);

SELECT UP.[UserId], UP.[DOB], UP.[Gender], UP.[BloodGroup], UP.[PersonalEmail], UP.[DateOfJoining], UP.[PassportNumber], UP.[FatherName], UP.[MotherName], UP.[MaritalStatus], UP.[WeddingAnniversaryDate], UP.[SpouseName], UP.[SpouseDOB], UP.[HomeAddress1], UP.[HomeAddress2], UP.[City], UP.[State], UP.[HomeAddressCity], UP.[HomeAddressState], UP.[HomeAddressCountry], UP.[HomePhoneNumber], UP.[EmergencyContactNumber], UP.[EmergencyContactName], UP.[PrimarySkills], UP.[SecondarySkills], UP.[TertiarySkills], UP.[OtherSkills], UP.[Branch], UP.[LookUpCode], UP.[LinkedInUrl], U.[display_name] FROM [UserProfile] AS UP INNER JOIN [User] AS U ON U.[Id] = UP.[UserId] WHERE UP.[UserId] = @ProfileId;

SELECT UP.[UserId], UP.[DOB], UP.[Gender], UP.[BloodGroup], UP.[PersonalEmail], UP.[DateOfJoining], UP.[PassportNumber], UP.[FatherName], UP.[MotherName], UP.[MaritalStatus], UP.[WeddingAnniversaryDate], UP.[SpouseName], UP.[SpouseDOB], UP.[HomeAddress1], UP.[HomeAddress2], UP.[City], UP.[State], UP.[HomeAddressCity], UP.[HomeAddressState], UP.[HomeAddressCountry], UP.[HomePhoneNumber], UP.[EmergencyContactNumber], UP.[EmergencyContactName], UP.[PrimarySkills], UP.[SecondarySkills], UP.[TertiarySkills], UP.[OtherSkills], UP.[Branch], UP.[LookUpCode], UP.[LinkedInUrl] FROM [UserProfile] AS UP;
SELECT * FROM [AuthReferenceLookup] WHERE [Type] = @Type ORDER BY [Name] ASC;
UPDATE [User] SET [IsActive] = @IsActive, [UpdatedDateTime] = GETUTCDATE() WHERE [Id] = @UserId;

WITH ranked_activity AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [UserId] ORDER BY [LastActivityDateTime] DESC) AS [rank], [Id], [UserId], [LastLoginDateTime], [LastLogoutDateTime], [LastActivityDateTime], [LastActivityModule], [LastActionType], [LastActivityDetail], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDateTime], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [UpdateReason], [OwnerId], [IsActive], [IsDeleted], [IsApproved], [ApproverId], [ApprovedDateTime], [IsAuthorized], [AuthorizedById], [AuthorizedDateTime], [TenantId], [SubTenantId], [SysData], [CustomFields] FROM [UserActivity] WHERE @UserIds IS NOT NULL AND @UserIds <> '' AND [UserId] IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIds, ',')) ) SELECT [Id], [UserId], [LastLoginDateTime], [LastLogoutDateTime], [LastActivityDateTime], [LastActivityModule], [LastActionType], [LastActivityDetail], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDateTime], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [UpdateReason], [OwnerId], [IsActive], [IsDeleted], [IsApproved], [ApproverId], [ApprovedDateTime], [IsAuthorized], [AuthorizedById], [AuthorizedDateTime], [TenantId], [SubTenantId], [SysData], [CustomFields] FROM ranked_activity WHERE [rank] = 1;
UPDATE [User] SET [Email] = @Email, [PhoneNumber] = @PhoneNumber, [EmpId] = @EmpId, [UpdatedDateTime] = GETUTCDATE() WHERE [Id] = @UserId;
